title: Page 5
content_zh:
背对他的女子看不到表情，不过那红通通的耳朵好可爱，可爱到他很想舔舔看。惊觉到自己的想法跟变态没两样，他在她挣扎的时候放手了。
她很快离开他的掌握逃走了。
徐士凯却发现自己有种不舍的感觉，甚至有种诡异的想法——觉得救援来得太快，他还想好好认识那个有趣的小女人呢！
徐士凯从小就有个习惯，只要他有兴趣的事情，他就会想尽办法搞懂并且掌握它。课业是、运动是，就连事业也是，这种精神让他在各方面表现都很突出。
在某种意义上来说，他还满死心眼的，好胜心也强，对无法征服的事物有着顽强的偏执，非要得到手，好好研究之后……
再丢掉。
一连好几天，他都一直往姑姑的办公室跑，原因无他——那里有个让他感兴趣的人。
挺直的坐在电脑前打字，范蕙怡看也不看她办公桌对面的大型物体一眼，当然，对徐士凯的攀谈她一句话也没有回。
他没见过像她这样的人。
这几天他不知道挨了多少冷眼，可还是锲而不舍的来找她。刚开始他只是想她替他工作，但她就像顽石一样不肯点头。他不懂，明明他提出的条件就比姑姑好得太多，而且据说他的助理一职是公司里所有女性的梦想。
她越是这样，他就越想探究她的想法。
然后就变成这样，他一有空就往这里跑。
她不理他，他就硬是要让她注意他。
她明明不是那种一眼就会引人注目的美女，甚至连美女也称不上。她的头发整齐的扎在脑后，穿着深色的古板套装，看起来就是严肃又呆板的人，到底哪里吸引他呢？
首先，她身上总是香香的，很淡却沁人心脾的香味。
然后，她的皮肤很白，好像很久没晒过太阳了，也许是因为常常加班工作的关系。那白皙到接近透明的肌肤总是让他很想摸摸看，是不是像看起来那样有着丝绸的触感。
再来是她所有的东西都干干净净、清清爽爽，总让他觉得很安心也很舒服。
不像他接触过的女子，她看着他的时候没有一丝动摇或是想要讨好他的表情，反而像是把他当成烦人的障碍物。一对上她清冷的视线，他不知怎么就有种微妙的酥麻感。
她越是冷漠，他就越想逗弄她，想看她除了冷漠以外的表情。
“中午到了，休息一下，我们一起吃饭吧？”徐士凯说。

在这只有两个人的空间里，范蕙怡不可能没听到，可是她只是站起身去拿列印出来的文件，没理他。
徐雪龄从办公室里出来，看到自己的侄子又出现在这时已经不太惊讶了。
“士凯，你又来想要拐走我的助理了？”
“嘿，姑姑，你好，要去吃饭了吗？”
“嗯，我约了人呢！蕙怡，我很需要你，你可别被拐走了，像公司里其他女孩子一样被他迷得晕头转向的。我这侄子啊！花心得很，要说工作的话，还是当我这个老太婆的助理比较安稳。”
“姑姑。”听到自家姑母这么毒舌的评论，徐士凯不由得苦笑。
“我知道，我绝对不会转职的，请您放心。”
想不到范蕙怡毫不犹豫的回答对他的打击更大，他苦着一张脸，“我没那么糟吧？”
难得看这个从小就事事顺利的优秀侄子吃瘪，徐雪龄得意的呵呵笑着离开。
徐士凯无奈的看着姑姑的背影，转头，看到范蕙怡起身要走，连忙追上去。
“你去哪？我们不是要一起吃饭吗？”
“不用了，我有带便当？”
“便当？你自己做的菜？”
“是。”
“你还会做菜？这么优秀！你做的菜怎么样？我想尝尝看。”
范蕙怡终于忍无可忍的停下脚步瞪他。“你会不会太闲了？”
英俊的男人对她展开一个迷死人的笑容。“我只是对你很有兴趣而已。”
“为什么？我只是个很平凡的上班族。”范蕙怡实在对他这几天的行为感到不解，她做了什么有幸得到公司最有价值单身汉注目的的事？只不过是在电梯里的镇定反应获得他的赞赏？那也不用一直来纠缠她啊！
“我也不知道。”他耸肩。
确实，他不知道，只是在她身边很舒服，他不用像跟别的女人在一起时那样，忙着应付对方明显的引诱。她对他没兴趣，恨不得他离得远远的，她的表现那么明显，他反而觉得新鲜有趣。

就连被她无视、被她瞪、被她斥责都有种很愉快的感觉。
“对了，你的便当到底有什么菜？快
范蕙怡彻底的无言了。
第3章(1)
流言在公司很快传开，公司的少东徐士凯迷上了董事助理范蕙怡。范蕙怡是谁？一定是大美女吧？否则怎能引起跟一堆名模女星交往过的徐士凯的兴趣？
答案跌破所有人的眼镜，范蕙怡长得也就一般般，就算路过也不会引人注目，只是工作能力还算不错——就这样。
是的，就这样。
范蕙怡在别的部门受了一堆气刚回到办公司，那个让她气恼的人却正好整以暇的坐在她的位子上。
“你又来干么？”
她的语气比往常火爆，他不由抬了抬头。
“怎么了？今天心情不好？”
她咬牙瞪他一眼。也不想想是谁害的。“请离开我的座位，不像某人，我还有很多工作要做。”
徐士凯站起身了，不过却不同意她的指控。“我不是没事可做，我是在延揽人才。怎样，你改变心意了没有？到我的部门工作吧？薪水三倍。”
这条件可以说是破天荒的好了，一般人不可能拒绝得了。不，应该说算没有薪水，能够待在他身边，这种工作一般人还是抢破了头。只是范蕙怡不想要。
这个男人太危险，太容易让人爱上，她最不需要的就是爱上一个每个女人都想要的男人。
“要我说几次？我不要！请不要再来骚扰我了。”
她不悦的挑起眉。“是我的错觉还是你真的很讨厌我？”
她没回答，选择对他来个相应不理，殊不知这反而更挑起他想一探究竟的心情。
太奇怪了，他还没有被谁那么讨厌、那么无视过。
“为什么？”他凑到她面前，把她的椅子转过来，双手撑在椅背，让她没办法逃开。

“我做了什么惹你生气吗？”
“没有。”范蕙怡全身因为他的靠近而僵硬，心跳不受控制，他的气味带着野性的麝香，一下子席卷了她所有的感官，她只能尽量克制自己的反应，并祈祷他没有听见她的心跳声。
“那你为什么老是拒绝我？”
他自大的质问让她想笑。怎么？他徐大少爷就那么没办法接受别人的拒绝吗？
想必从来都没有女人会对他说不吧？
只可惜她此刻紧缩的喉咙发布出声来。范蕙怡别开眼。
她这个小小的动作让他的心漏跳了一拍。她偏过头的模样竟有种说不出的风情，这么近的距离他可以看到原来在她眼镜底下有着有浓有密的睫毛，那双闪躲的眼睛也黑白分明，相当迷人。
这时候他又注意到她的脸颊泛起红晕，那可爱的潮红让四周的空气好像都变成粉红色的了。
心动，来的措手不及。
“你不想当我的助理，那么，当我的女朋友吧？”
话一出，别说是她，连他自己也吓一跳。
“开、开什么玩笑？”范蕙怡推开他，刚刚还是粉红色的脸颊现在涨得通红。
“这、这种笑话一点都不好笑！”
content_en:
The expression of the woman with her back to him could not be seen, but her red ears were so cute that he wanted to lick them. Shocked to realize that his thoughts were no different than those of a pervert, he let go when she struggled.
She quickly escaped from his grasp and fled.
However, Xu Shikai found that he had a feeling of reluctance, and even had a strange thought - he felt that the rescue came too quickly, and he still wanted to get to know that interesting little woman!
Xu Shikai has had a habit since he was a child. As long as he is interested in something, he will try his best to understand and master it. It's schoolwork, sports, and even career. This spirit makes him outstanding in all aspects.
In a sense, he is also very stubborn and competitive, and has a stubborn obsession with things that cannot be conquered. He insists on getting his hands on it, and after careful study...
Throw it away again.
For several days, he kept running to his aunt's office for no other reason than there was someone there who interested him.
Sitting upright in front of the computer and typing, Fan Huiyi didn't even look at the large object opposite her desk. Of course, she didn't reply to Xu Shikai's conversation.
He had never seen anyone like her.
He didn't know how many cold looks he had received in the past few days, but he still persevered in coming to her. At first he just wanted her to work for him, but she was as stubborn as a stone and refused to nod. He didn't understand. The conditions he proposed were obviously much better than those of his aunt, and it was said that his assistant position was the dream of all women in the company.
The more she acted like this, the more he wanted to explore her thoughts.
Then it became like this, he would run here whenever he had free time.
She ignored him, but he insisted on getting her to pay attention to him.
She is obviously not the kind of beauty who will attract attention at a glance, and she cannot even be called a beauty. Her hair was neatly tied back and she was wearing a dark, old-fashioned suit. She looked like a serious and dull person. What attracted him to her?
First of all, she always smells good, a very light but refreshing fragrance.
Then, her skin was very white, as if she hadn't been exposed to the sun for a long time, maybe because she often worked overtime. The skin that was so white that it was almost transparent always made him want to touch it to see if it had the touch of silk as it looked.
Furthermore, all her things were clean and fresh, which always made him feel at ease and comfortable.
Unlike the women he had come into contact with, she didn't look wavering or wanted to please him when she looked at him. Instead, she seemed to regard him as an annoying obstacle. When he met her cold gaze, he felt a subtle tingling feeling for some reason.
The more indifferent she was, the more he wanted to tease her and see her expression other than indifference.
"It's noon. Let's take a rest. Let's have dinner together?" Xu Shikai said.
In this space with only two people, it was impossible for Fan Huiyi not to hear it, but she just stood up to get the printed document and ignored him.
Xu Xueling came out of the office and was not too surprised to see her nephew appear again.
"Shikai, are you trying to kidnap my assistant again?"
"Hey, aunt, hello, are you going to eat?"
"Well, I have an appointment! Hui Yi, I need you very much. Don't get kidnapped and be confused by him like other girls in the company. My nephew! He is very carefree. When it comes to work, it is more stable to be the assistant of an old woman like me."
"Aunt." Xu Shikai couldn't help but smile bitterly when he heard his aunt's venomous comments.
"I know, I will never change jobs, please don't worry."
Unexpectedly, Fan Huiyi's unhesitating answer hit him even harder. He made a grimace and said, "I'm not that bad, am I?"
It was rare to see this outstanding nephew who had been doing everything well since he was a child frustrated. Xu Xueling left with a proud smile.
Xu Shikai looked helplessly at his aunt's back, turned around, saw Fan Huiyi getting up to leave, and quickly chased after her.
"Where are you going? Aren't we going to have dinner together?"
"No need, did I bring a lunch box?"
"Lunchbox? Did you cook it yourself?"
"Yes."
"You can also cook? You are so good! How do you like the food you cook? I want to try it."
Fan Huiyi finally stopped and stared at him. "Are you too busy?"
The handsome man gave her a charming smile. "I'm just very interested in you."
"Why? I'm just an ordinary office worker." Fan Huiyi was really puzzled by his behavior these days. What did she do to get the attention of the most valuable bachelor in the company? Was it just a calm reaction in the elevator that earned him praise? Then there is no need to pester her all the time!
"I don't know either." He shrugged.
Indeed, he didn't know, it was just that he felt comfortable around her, and he didn't have to deal with her obvious temptation like he did with other women. She was not interested in him and wished he would stay far away. Her performance was so obvious, but he found it fresh and interesting.
Even being ignored by her, glared at by her, and scolded by her was a pleasant feeling.
"By the way, what's in your lunch box? Come on.
Fan Huiyi was completely speechless.
Chapter 3(1)
Rumors quickly spread in the company that Xu Shikai, the company's young boss, was obsessed with Fan Huiyi, the assistant director. Who is Fan Huiyi? She must be a beautiful woman, right? Otherwise, how could it arouse the interest of Xu Shikai, who has dated a bunch of supermodels and actresses?
The answer was beyond everyone's expectations. Fan Huiyi looked just average. She wouldn't attract attention even if she passed by, but her work ability was pretty good - that's it.
Yes, that's it.
Fan Huiyi had just returned to the office after suffering a lot of anger in other departments, but the person who made her angry happened to be sitting in her seat.
"What are you doing here again? "
Her tone was more fiery than usual, and he couldn't help but raise his head.
"What's wrong? Are you in a bad mood today? "
She gritted her teeth and glared at him. I don’t even think about who caused it. “Please get out of my seat, unlike someone, I have a lot of work to do. "
Xu Shikai stood up, but disagreed with her accusation. “It’s not that I have nothing to do, I’m recruiting talents. What, have you changed your mind? Would you like to work in my department? Three times the salary. "
This condition can be said to be unprecedented, and it is impossible for ordinary people to refuse it. No, it should be said that even if there is no salary, being able to stay by his side is still a job that most people would grab. It’s just that Fan Huiyi doesn’t want it.
This man was too dangerous, too easy to fall in love with, and the last thing she needed was to fall in love with a man that every woman wanted.
"How many times do you want me to say it? I don't want it! Please stop harassing me. "
She raised her eyebrows in displeasure. "Is it my imagination or do you really hate me? "
She didn't answer and chose to ignore him, but little did she know that this only aroused his desire to find out more.
It's so strange that he has never been so hated or ignored by anyone.
"Why? "He came up to her, turned her chair around, and put his hands on the back of the chair so that she couldn't escape.
"Did I do something to make you angry? "
"No. "Fan Huiyi's whole body stiffened because of his approach, and her heartbeat was uncontrollable. His scent, with its wild musk, swept through all her senses. She could only try to restrain her reaction and pray that he didn't hear her heartbeat.
"Then why do you always reject me? "
His cocky question made her want to laugh. What? Is he, Young Master Xu, so unable to accept rejection from others?
Surely no woman would ever say no to him, right?
It's a pity that her throat was constricted at this moment and she couldn't make a sound. Fan Huiyi looked away.
Her small gesture made his heart skip a beat. There was an indescribable charm in the way she tilted her head. From such a close distance, he could see what was happening in front of her.There are thick eyelashes under the mirror, and the dodgey eyes are also clear in black and white, which is quite charming.
At this time, he noticed a blush on her cheeks again. That lovely flush made the air around her seem to turn pink.
The heartbeat came unexpectedly.
"If you don't want to be my assistant, then how about you be my girlfriend?"
As soon as the words came out, let alone her, even he was shocked.
"Are you kidding me?" Fan Huiyi pushed him away, her cheeks that were just pink now turned red.
"This, this kind of joke is not funny at all!"
